room_or_space: FIRST FLOOR PLAN (whole floor): Storage (left end), Billiards, Vestibule, Boiler Room, Laundry Rm., Storage, Clos., Stair, Game Room, Court Yard, Garage, Storage (right end)

overall_dimensions.length: 92'-0" (overall length of the upper long wall, from the vestibule corner to the right end of the garage/storage wing, as written)

proportions.notable_proportion: A 4'-0" pier/mullion module is repeated along the upper and lower walls of the Billiards room (5 bays each) and along the upper wall above the boiler room (4 bays); every window group between piers is 1'-3" + 2'-9" + 1'-3" (vestibule: 11½" + 2'-9" + 11½"). Billiards room inside width 22'-6" (vertical string); garage 18'-0" vertical; stair run 3'-0" between 10" walls. The plan is very long and narrow in relation to its depth.

layout.organisation: Long, narrow linear plan drawn horizontally. A main bar runs along the lower part of the sheet: left-end Storage room flanked by two stairs, a pointed bay, the Billiards room, a solid hatched central mass containing a stair, the Game Room with an angled bay, and the open Court Yard at the right end. A service bar is set back along the upper long wall: Vestibule, Boiler Room, Laundry Rm. with a small stair, Storage, Clos., a straight Stair, the Garage and a right-end Storage room. All walls are hatched and heavy; the two bars overlap only at the vestibule/central mass.
layout.axes: A single long horizontal centreline is drawn through Storage, Billiards, the central mass, Game Room and Court Yard; both the left-end pointed bay and the angled bay on the right side of the Game Room sit on this axis. The service wing runs parallel to it along the 92'-0" upper wall. Cross-axes are not drawn; vertical dimension strings are set at the Billiards room walls only.
layout.entry_sequence: The Vestibule sits at the junction of the main bar and the service wing, on the upper wall; it opens to the Billiards room below it and to the Boiler Room / Clos. beside it. From the Billiards room the sequence runs through the central stair/fireplace mass into the Game Room and out to the Court Yard. Stairs marked UP (with direction arrows) occur at five points: two flanking the left-end Storage room, one in the central mass, one off the Laundry/Storage (marked DN and UP), and the straight Stair beside the Garage.
layout.circulation: Linear circulation along the long axis: Storage - pointed bay - Billiards - central mass - Game Room - Court Yard. The Game Room's lower wall has a row of door swing arcs between piers; the Garage's lower edge is open between stepped piers toward the Court Yard. Service rooms are reached from the Vestibule and from the Laundry stair; the Court Yard is bounded by a thin stepped wall at the lower right with a 1'-4" step.

details: Regular 4'-0" pier module along the long walls with an identical narrow window group (1'-3" + 2'-9" + 1'-3") in each bay
Pointed (prow-shaped) bay at the left end of the Billiards room and an angled bay on the right side of the Game Room, both on the drawn long axis
Thick hatched masses with stairs set inside them; the central mass between Billiards and Game Room is a large solid block with an internal stair
Walls stepped and offset: the service wing sits on a different wall line from the main rooms, with 10" walls and short 2'-4" / 2'-6" jogs
Row of door swing arcs on the lower wall of the Game Room and stepped piers along the Garage edge toward the Court Yard
